title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore Beloit College and the surrounding community with these social activities and spaces that require no admission fee or purchase.

cards.title: Logan Museum of Anthropology
cards.subtitle: Beloit College Campus
cards.notes: Explore global cultures through over 300,000 ethnographic and archaeological objects. Admission is free for all visitors during regular gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A teaching museum of anthropology with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Logan Museum of Anthropology offers free admission to the public and is located on the Beloit College campus.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information - Logan Museum of Anthropology - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Wright Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Beloit College Campus
cards.notes: View a permanent collection of 6,000 works and rotating student exhibitions. Entry to the galleries is free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: Campus art museum featuring diverse collections with free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wright Museum of Art is open to the public with free admission and features rotating exhibits.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information - Wright Museum of Art - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Beloit College Effigy Mounds
cards.subtitle: Beloit College Campus
cards.notes: Walk among 20 prehistoric Native American mounds, including the turtle-shaped mound that inspired the school mascot. The site is a free outdoor landmark.
cards.short_summary: Historic Native American earthworks located on the campus grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Beloit College campus features 20 unique animal-shaped effigy mounds that are accessible to the public for free.
cards.source_title: What the public can do at Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor site accessible during daylight hours.

cards.title: Riverside Park
cards.subtitle: Rock River Waterfront
cards.notes: Stroll the 3.5-mile paved River Walk or use the lighted tennis courts. This 23-acre park offers free admission and scenic views of the Rock River.
cards.short_summary: A large riverfront park with walking paths and recreational facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Riverside Park offers free admission and features the 3.5-mile Beloit River Walk and lighted tennis courts.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: The Powerhouse
cards.subtitle: Student Union & Recreation Center
cards.notes: Hang out in the common areas of this award-winning converted power plant. Students can access the indoor track and lounges without additional fees.
cards.short_summary: A repurposed power plant serving as a student union and fitness hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Powerhouse is a student union and recreation center where students can hang out and use facilities like the track.
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays 8 a.m. to 7 p.m., weekends 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.

cards.title: Big Hill Park
cards.subtitle: Rock River Bluffs
cards.notes: Hike the nature trails to reach the scenic overlook on the bluffs. This 190-acre park is free to enter and offers spectacular vistas of the river valley.
cards.short_summary: Scenic park on the bluffs with hiking trails and a river overlook.
cards.evidence_claim: Big Hill Park offers free admission and features nature trails and a scenic overlook.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Activities • The Powerhouse - Beloit College
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.entity_name: Sanger Center for the Sciences Atrium
cards.title: Sanger Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Science Center Hub
cards.notes: Study or meet friends in the four-story light-filled atrium. This central campus space is open for student use and features modern architecture.
cards.short_summary: A large, modern atrium inside the campus science center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sanger Center for the Sciences features a four-story atrium used for student gatherings and study.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; security required for evening/weekend access.

cards.title: Morse Library
cards.subtitle: Campus Library
cards.notes: Utilize group study rooms or quiet carrels for collaborative work. The library provides various free academic environments for the college community.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering diverse study and research spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Morse Library provides group study rooms and carrels that are free for student use.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; hours vary by day.

cards.entity_name: Dr. George W. Hilliard Park Disc Golf Course
cards.title: Hilliard Park Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: 9-Hole Course
cards.notes: Play a round of disc golf at this 9-hole course set among large oak trees. The course is free to the public and located in a nearby neighborhood park.
cards.short_summary: A free 9-hole disc golf course located in a local city park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dr. George W. Hilliard Park Disc Golf Course offers free admission for players.
cards.source_title: Dr. George W. Hilliard Park Disc Golf Course | Travel Wisconsin
cards.access_notes: Open during park hours, sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: Outdoor Art Trail
cards.subtitle: Citywide Sculpture Walk
cards.notes: Follow a self-guided tour of sculptures and murals throughout campus and downtown. This activity is free and highlights local artistic history.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided walking tour of public art installations in Beloit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beloit & Beyond Outdoor Art Trail is a free self-guided activity featuring sculptures and art pieces.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Things To Do For Beloit College Students
cards.access_notes: Accessible anytime; best viewed during daylight hours.
